title: Echoes of Egypt
description:
Step into the vibrant world of "Echoes of Egypt," an innovative action-indie-arcade game that brings historical art to life. This game transforms traditional 2D gameplay into an immersive 3D experience.

Hathor is an ancient Egyptian goddess of music, joy, and motherhood, but also of divine wrath when provoked. You've entered her domain uninvited. The goddess appears in both her iconic cow-headed form and her human form, tracking your progress through the cube. She's been watching since you arrived, and she's waiting at the end to settle the score.

Every surface in Hathor's Cube responds to the beat. Hieroglyphs dance. Obstacles pulse. The soundtrack blends 1980s synths with Middle Eastern instruments, and it drives everything you see and everything trying to kill you.
description_short: A music-driven 2.5D rhythm-platformer where every obstacle pulses with the music. A short (mis)adventure through the goddess Hathor's domain, where every hieroglyph dances to the beat — and she's waiting at the end.
